queries.fact_scan: SELECT customer_state,count(*) orders,sum(merchandise_brl) merchandise,sum(late_eligible) eligible,sum(coalesce(is_late,0)) late FROM fact_orders WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-01-31' GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_state
queries.daily_mart: SELECT customer_state,sum(orders) orders,sum(merchandise_brl) merchandise,sum(eligible_delivered) eligible,sum(late_orders) late FROM mart_delivery_daily WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-01-31' GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_state

limits: Single host, 2 DuckDB threads, warm caches, alternating variants; other services may be running. Measures query execution+fetch only. Not whole-pipeline throughput or scale-out evidence.
